description: Email notification sent to student when their meal account is topped up by a parent/guardian
subject: Meal Account Top-Up Notification
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your meal account has been topped up!

Amount Added: £$amount
New Balance: £$new_balance
Date: $topup_datetime

This top-up was made by your parent/guardian through the Family Portal.

If you have any questions, please contact the Student Services office.

Best regards,
University Management System
